sar.narrative: On November 22, 2016, a suspicious transaction (ID: 3478561) was identified involving customer C13487 and card C13487-K1. The transaction was flagged due to a card-not-present activity originating from a new device profile (D005668). Graph analysis revealed that this specific device profile was shared across 51 distinct card accounts, indicating a coordinated effort. This pattern strongly suggests an organized credential ring attempting to exploit compromised card data. The total financial exposure associated with this specific alert is $74.96. The activity was detected through our automated fraud detection systems, which identified the anomalous device sharing. The involvement of multiple unrelated card accounts on a single device is a hallmark of organized fraud. This report is filed in accordance with FinCEN regulations to report suspicious activity indicative of money laundering or fraud. The institution has taken immediate steps to secure the affected accounts and investigate the broader network. Further monitoring will be applied to the identified device and associated accounts.

stop_reason: Verification confirmed card compromise; exposure quantified and protective policy actions enforced. Further steps would not change actions.
